comment:
Writes v17/fixtures.json: the conformance floor of the N letter as DRAWN (n_v17.haro, n/tontine.n).

Composed from the letter's own declared MESSAGES and CODES and from the rules in GRAMMAR.md -- before the
checks that judge them were run on these cases (the W discipline: fixtures first). Two kinds:

  court   a defect the EXISTING meta-vocabulary makes the forged court refuse: its message must hold the
          text declared in n_v17.haro, and `diagnose` must carry the code declared there
  rule    a defect the existing court CANNOT see (it must still say `ok`) and the rule of the next rung must
          catch: n_model.rules() must answer the code. Each is what v0.17 would add as a check

Each case is one replacement in n/tontine.n, anchored: the old text must occur exactly once.

court.name: a column keyed by a tongue nobody declared
a frame whose shape names no meaning
court.old: SHAPE [show, deposit, over, num], TARGET ledger
court.new: SHAPE [show, deposit, ovr, num], TARGET ledger
court.message: FRAME ledger_over has 'ovr' in its SHAPE, which is not a declared meaning

court.name: a frame aimed at no surface
court.message: FRAME ledger_all is aimed at 'ledgr', which is not a declared surface

court.name: an example that means no frame
court.message: EXAMPLE p01 means 'ledger_ovr', which is not a declared frame

court.name: a step aimed at no surface
court.old: TARGET graph, QUERY "?x received_pot_in round{num}", BINDS member
court.new: TARGET grph, QUERY "?x received_pot_in round{num}", BINDS member
court.message: STEP find_beneficiary is aimed at 'grph', which is not a declared surface

court.name: a surface that tells in no tongue
court.message: SURFACE ledger tells in 'german', which is not a declared tongue

court.name: a meaning that draws from no surface
court.old: SLOT entity, OF member, FROM graph
court.new: SLOT entity, OF member, FROM grph
court.message: MEANING member draws its entities from 'grph', which is not a declared surface

court.name: an alias of no meaning
court.message: ALIAS treasurer is of 'rol', which is not a declared meaning

court.name: a declaration N does not have: N never declares
court.new:
DEFINE NORM positive_deposit AS (RULE "amount > 0") RATIONALE "x"

DEFINE STEP find_beneficiary AS (
court.message: N asks; it never declares the world, the facts or a rule

a spelling that does not exist

court.old: KIND query, GRAMMAR "ZQL ASK", COURT "z_court.ring ask",

court.name: a declaration without its rationale
court.old:
DEFINE ALIAS collector AS (
  MEANING role, ENTITY "collector",
  WORDS [english: "collector", french: "collecteur"]
) RATIONALE "The member who takes the deposits"
court.new:
DEFINE ALIAS collector AS (
  MEANING role, ENTITY "collector",
  WORDS [english: "collector", french: "collecteur"]
)
court.message: RATIONALE is mandatory on every declaration
